lines.speaker: cultist_unknown
lines.text: You have a ship. We can smell the fuel on you. That is a compliment.

lines.speaker: charlie
lines.text: ...Thanks? Can I help you two with something?

lines.speaker: cultist_unknown
lines.text: Perhaps. We are always interested in ships that travel farther than their owners planned.

lines.speaker: cultist_unknown
lines.text: Pilgrims. Travellers. Two humble voices of a very old choir. Nobody important. Please forget our faces.

lines.speaker: cultist_unknown
lines.text: The robes are warm, the hoods are practical, and strangers ask fewer questions than you might expect.

lines.speaker: cultist_unknown
lines.text: If you are looking for work, courier, ask.

lines.speaker: cultist_unknown
lines.text: The taller one smiles. Not work, exactly. A favour. Come, sit.

lines.speaker: cultist_unknown
lines.text: A third robe steps out behind you. By the time you reach the docks, four crates are missing.

lines.speaker: cultist_unknown
lines.text: A small courier job. Easy money, no questions. Six crates for your trouble.

lines.speaker: cultist_unknown
lines.text: The quiet one watches you all the way back to the docks.

options.line: I think I will keep walking.
All right. What is the job?
